errors.title: A little pause
errors.invalidSubmission: Your thought needs one more look. Please check your words and the place you've chosen, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: There's no rush. Please wait a little before leaving another thought.
errors.submissionFailed: Your thought hasn't found its place yet. Your words are still here, ready for you to try again.

errors.storage: We couldn't remember your moments in this browser. Please allow this site to save data, then try again.
errors.mapUnavailable: The world is still coming into view. Give the map a moment, then try again.

errors.unhandledPromise: That moment didn't quite come together. Please try again, or reload the page.
